title: The team services' single-instance lock of protocol 1
description: The value under team_services.<team> in UA1_LOCKS, as JSON. It is not signed: only the team services may write the bucket, and only a compare-and-set on the key's revision proves who holds the lock. The instance id tells two processes of one runtime apart, since every team services instance runs as the same runtime (README, "The team services' lock").

runtime.description: The runtime id of the team services instance that holds the lock.

instance.description: A random id the process chose when it started, at least 64 bits as lowercase hexadecimal.

lease_ends_at.description: When the holder's lease ends: 30 seconds after it last wrote the lock.
